series.name: Light-commercial ABNML alarm codes (10.2 ALARM CODES heat pump + cooling only)
series.notes: Light-commercial manual chapter 10.2 ALARM CODES (blogspot copy of airconwarehouse troubleshooting). Wired remote ABNML + unit ID + code; outdoor PCB LED1-LED4 patterns. Medium-high (manual copy).

meaning.en: An indoor-unit safety device opened and cut out the compressor; the remote shows ABNML with the unit ID and code 01.
meaning.ur: Indoor unit ka safety device khul gaya aur compressor ko band kar diya; remote par ABNML ke saath unit ID aur code 01 nazar aata hai

causes.en: Indoor freeze/thermal protection or float device opened on the indoor circuit.
causes.ur: Indoor circuit par freeze/thermal protection ya float device khul gaya

causes.en: Device wiring loose, or the protection device itself failed.
causes.ur: Device ki wiring dheeli hai, ya protection device khud kharab ho gaya hai

solutions.en: Find which indoor safety device opened, clear its cause (water, airflow, temperature) and reset.
solutions.ur: Dekhein kaun sa indoor safety device khula, us ki wajah (paani, airflow, temperature) hatayein aur reset karein

solutions.en: Verify device continuity and its harness; replace a failed device before restarting.
solutions.ur: Device ki continuity aur us ka harness check karein; dobara chalane se pehle kharab device badal dein

notes.en: Heat-pump table. Cooling-only variant of 01 is not published. Two further Scribd copies of the same chapter exist (515729911, 998800254) - derivative of one origin, so not double-counted for confidence.
notes.ur: Yeh heat-pump table se hai. 01 ki cooling-only wali variant publish nahi hui. Usi chapter ke do aur Scribd copies maujood hain (515729911, 998800254) — sab ek hi source se bane hain, is liye confidence mein dobara count nahi kiye gaye.

codes.blinkPattern: Remote LCD: ABNML + unit ID + 01; outdoor PCB LED1 lit

meaning.en: An outdoor-unit safety device opened and cut out the compressor (shown as ABNML + unit ID + 02).
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit ka safety device khul gaya aur compressor ko band kar diya (ABNML + unit ID + 02 ke tor par)

causes.en: Outdoor high/low pressure switch, overload or another outdoor protection device opened.
causes.ur: Outdoor high/low pressure switch, overload ya koi doosra outdoor protection device khul gaya

causes.en: Dirty condenser, blocked airflow, overcharge, or a failed protection device.
causes.ur: Ganda condenser, band airflow, zyada charge ya koi protection device kharab

solutions.en: Check which outdoor protection device is open (meter across the device) and clear its cause.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke kaunsa outdoor protection device khuli hui hai (device ke aar par meter lagayein) aur us ki wajah theek karein

solutions.en: Clean the condenser, verify fan and charge, then reset with the Run/Stop button.
solutions.ur: Condenser saaf karein, fan aur charge check karein, phir Run/Stop button se reset karein

notes.en: Present in BOTH heat-pump and cooling-only tables (cooling-only wording: safety device indoor or outdoor unit).
notes.ur: Yeh heat-pump aur cooling-only dono tables mein maujood hai (cooling-only ka wording: safety device, kamre wala ya bahar wala).

codes.blinkPattern: Remote LCD: ABNML + unit ID + 02; outdoor PCB LED2 lit

title.en: Transmission between indoor and outdoor units

meaning.en: Signal transmission between the indoor and outdoor units failed, so the remote latches ABNML 03.
meaning.ur: Dono units ke darmiyan signal transmission nakam hui, is liye remote par ABNML 03 latch ho jata hai

causes.en: Inter-unit cable open/short, or loose terminal connections at either unit.
causes.ur: Inter-unit cable khuli ya short, ya kisi aik unit par terminal connections dheele hain

causes.en: Indoor or outdoor communication PCB fault, or strong electrical noise on the line.
causes.ur: Kamre wale ya bahar wale unit ki communication PCB kharab, ya line par bohat zyada electrical shor

solutions.en: Check inter-unit wiring continuity and re-tighten both terminal boxes.
solutions.ur: Inter-unit wiring ki continuity check karein aur dono terminal boxes dobara kassain

solutions.en: Keep communication wiring away from power wiring; replace the faulty PCB if wiring tests good.
solutions.ur: Communication wiring ko power wiring se door rakhein; wiring theek nikle to kharab PCB badal dein

notes.en: Corroborated by the official Hitachi RPI-FSN3 operation manual (03 = Communication) and by the official Solvers video on error code 03.
notes.ur: Official Hitachi RPI-FSN3 operation manual (03 = Communication) aur official Solvers video (error code 03) ise confirm karte hain.

codes.blinkPattern: Remote LCD: ABNML + unit ID + 03; outdoor PCB LED3 lit

meaning.en: The three-phase supply phase sequence is reversed, or an open phase is present.
meaning.ur: Teen phase supply ki tar palat hui hai, ya koi phase khuli hui hai

causes.en: Phases landed in the wrong order at the outdoor unit after supply or wiring work.
causes.ur: Supply ya wiring ke kaam ke baad outdoor unit par phases ghalat order mein lage gaye

causes.en: One phase missing (open phase) or a loose supply link.
causes.ur: Aik phase ghaayab (open phase) hai, ya supply link dheela hai

solutions.en: Check phase sequence at the outdoor terminals with a phase-sequence meter and swap any two phases.
solutions.ur: Phase sequence meter se outdoor terminals par phase sequence check karein aur kisi bhi do phases swap kar dein

solutions.en: Verify all three phases are present and tight before restarting the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit dobara chalane se pehle teenon phases ki mojoodgi aur tightness check karein

notes.en: Agrees with the SET FREE / air365 row for 05 (power-supply phase abnormality). Three-phase hazard - treated as danger.
notes.ur: Yeh SET FREE / air365 ke 05 (power-supply phase abnormality) se agree karta hai. Three-phase khatra hai — isay khatre ki tarah treat kiya jata hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Remote LCD: ABNML + unit ID + 05; outdoor PCB LED4 lit

meaning.en: Compressor discharge/gas temperature exceeded the safe value and the unit shut down.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki discharge/gas temperature safe value se zyada ho gayi aur unit band ho gaya

causes.en: Low refrigerant charge, pipe clogging, or a failed discharge thermistor.
causes.ur: Refrigerant charge kam, pipe ka rakaav, ya discharge ka thermistor kharab

causes.en: Dirty condenser or slow outdoor fan causing poor heat rejection at high ambient.
causes.ur: Ganda condenser ya slow outdoor fan ki wajah se high ambient par heat rejection kamzor ho raha hai

solutions.en: Leak-test, evacuate and recharge to specification; clean the condenser and confirm fan speed.
solutions.ur: Leak test karein, evacuate karke specification ke mutabiq recharge karein; condenser saaf karein aur fan ki speed check karein

solutions.en: Measure the discharge thermistor and replace it if out of specification; otherwise service the compressor.
solutions.ur: Discharge thermistor napen; specification se bahar ho to badal dein, warna compressor ki marammat karein

notes.en: Same physical meaning as official alarm 08 (compressor discharge temperature too high) explained in Hitachi's official Solvers video.
notes.ur: Yeh official alarm 08 (compressor discharge temperature bohat zyada) ke barabar hi hai, jise Hitachi ke official Solvers video mein samjaya gaya hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Remote LCD: ABNML + unit ID + 08; outdoor PCB LED1+LED2+LED3 lit

meaning.en: The indoor air-inlet (room) temperature sensor is reading out of range.
meaning.ur: Indoor ka air inlet (room) temperature sensor range se bahar parh raha hai

causes.en: Thermistor open/short from moisture, age or physical damage.
causes.ur: Nami, umar ya physical damage ki wajah se thermistor open/short ho gaya

causes.en: Loose sensor connector or damaged sensor harness.
causes.ur: Sensor ka connector dheela ya sensor ka harness kharab

solutions.en: Measure sensor resistance at room temperature and compare with the service-manual value.
solutions.ur: Room temperature par sensor ki resistance napen aur service manual ki value se compare karein

solutions.en: Refit the connector or replace the thermistor; if it still reads wrong, check the control board input.
solutions.ur: Connector wapas lagayein ya thermistor badal dein; phir bhi ghalat parhe to control board ka input check karein

notes.en: In both heat-pump and cooling-only tables. The source publishes one LED row for the 11-13 group (all four LEDs).
notes.ur: Yeh heat-pump aur cooling-only dono tables mein hai. Source ne 11-13 group ke liye ek hi LED row publish ki hai (charo LED).

codes.blinkPattern: Remote LCD: ABNML + unit ID + 11; outdoor PCB LED1+LED2+LED3+LED4 lit (source groups 11-13)

meaning.en: The indoor air-outlet temperature sensor is reading out of range.
meaning.ur: Indoor ka air outlet temperature sensor range se bahar parh raha hai

causes.en: Thermistor open/short, or its connector not seated.
causes.ur: Thermistor open/short, ya us ka connector theek se nahi baitha

causes.en: Damaged harness between the sensor and the control board.
causes.ur: Sensor aur control board ke darmiyan harness kharab

solutions.en: Check the sensor resistance and connector; replace a sensor that reads open/short.
solutions.ur: Sensor ki resistance aur connector check karein; open/short dikhane wala sensor badal dein

solutions.en: After refitting, run the unit and confirm the displayed temperature follows reality.
solutions.ur: Dobara lagane ke baad unit chala kar dekhein ke dikhaya gaya temperature haqeeqat se mutabiq hota hai ya nahi.

notes.en: Cooling-only table also lists 12 (wording: air outlet thermistor).
notes.ur: Cooling-only table mein 12 bhi likha hai (wording: air outlet thermistor).

codes.blinkPattern: Remote LCD: ABNML + unit ID + 12; outdoor PCB LED1+LED2+LED3+LED4 lit (source groups 11-13)

meaning.en: The indoor freeze-protection sensor opened, shorted or reads out of range and blocks the unit.
meaning.ur: Indoor ka freeze protection sensor khul gaya, short ho gaya ya range se bahar parh raha hai aur unit rok raha hai

causes.en: Sensor open/short, loose connector or damaged harness.
causes.ur: Sensor open/short, connector dheela ya harness kharab

causes.en: Actual evaporator freeze-up from low airflow (dirty filter/fan) feeding a genuine freeze condition.
causes.ur: Kam airflow (ganda filter/fan) ki wajah se evaporator par freeze-up ho gaya

solutions.en: Test the thermistor value and replace it if open/short; refit the connector.
solutions.ur: Thermistor ki value test karein; open/short ho to badal dein aur connector dobara lagayein

solutions.en: If the sensor is good, clean the filter and check airflow across the evaporator before resetting.
solutions.ur: Sensor theek ho to filter saaf karein aur reset se pehle evaporator par airflow check karein

notes.ur: Cooling-only table mein 13 bhi usi wording ke saath likha hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Remote LCD: ABNML + unit ID + 13; outdoor PCB LED1+LED2+LED3+LED4 lit (source groups 11-13)

meaning.en: The compressor-temperature sensor is out of range, so the unit stops for protection.
meaning.ur: Compressor temperature sensor range se bahar hai, is liye unit protection ke liye ruk jata hai

causes.en: Sensor open/short or its wiring damaged.
causes.ur: Sensor open/short ya us ki wiring kharab

causes.en: Sensor not seated on the compressor shell, giving a wrong reading.
causes.ur: Sensor compressor ki shell par theek se nahi baitha, jis se ghalat reading aati hai

solutions.en: Measure the sensor at room temperature and replace it if out of specification.
solutions.ur: Room temperature par sensor napen; specification se bahar ho to badal dein

solutions.en: Confirm the sensor is firmly clamped to the compressor and harness is intact.
solutions.ur: Tasdeeq karein ke sensor compressor par mazbooti se fit hai aur harness salamat hai

codes.blinkPattern: Remote LCD: ABNML + unit ID + 20; outdoor PCB LED1+LED4 lit

meaning.en: The outdoor ambient-air temperature sensor reads out of range.
meaning.ur: Outdoor ka mahol hawa temperature sensor range se bahar parh raha hai

causes.en: Sensor open/short from moisture ingress, corrosion or physical damage.
causes.ur: Nami ke aane, zang ya physical damage se sensor open/short ho gaya

causes.en: Loose or broken sensor wiring at the outdoor unit.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit par sensor ki wiring dheeli ya tooti hui hai

solutions.en: Check sensor resistance against the service-manual table and replace if bad.
solutions.ur: Sensor ki resistance service manual ki table se compare karke check karein aur kharab ho to badal dein

solutions.en: Dry and secure the connector, then reset the unit.
solutions.ur: Connector ko sukha karke mazboot lagayein, phir unit reset karein

notes.en: Heat-pump table only. Official SET FREE table defines the same-numbered 22 as outdoor-air thermistor - consistent.
notes.ur: Sirf heat-pump table mein hai. Official SET FREE table usi number 22 ko outdoor-air thermistor batati hai — bilkul consistent.

codes.blinkPattern: Remote LCD: ABNML + unit ID + 22; outdoor PCB LED1+LED2 lit

meaning.en: The outdoor coil defrost temperature sensor is out of range.
meaning.ur: Outdoor coil ka defrost temperature sensor range se bahar hai

causes.en: Sensor open/short or damaged harness on the outdoor coil.
causes.ur: Outdoor coil par sensor open/short ya harness kharab

causes.en: Sensor clip loose, so it reads the wrong surface temperature.
causes.ur: Sensor ka clip dheela hai, jis ki wajah se wo ghalat surface temperature parh raha hai

solutions.en: Verify and replace the sensor; re-clamp it firmly on the coil.
solutions.ur: Sensor check karke badal dein aur coil par mazbooti se dobara clamp karein

solutions.en: After repair, run a heating cycle and confirm defrost operates normally.
solutions.ur: Marammat ke baad heating cycle chala kar check karein ke defrost aam tor par kaam kar raha hai

notes.en: Heat-pump table only. Official SET FREE 24 is outdoor liquid-pipe thermistor - related but differently named (same-number-different-meaning case).
notes.ur: Sirf heat-pump table mein hai. Official SET FREE 24 outdoor liquid line ka thermistor hai — milta hai magar naam alag hai (same number, alag meaning wala case).

codes.blinkPattern: Remote LCD: ABNML + unit ID + 24; outdoor PCB LED1+LED3 lit

meaning.en: The sensor that measures condensing temperature is out of range.
meaning.ur: Jo sensor condensing temperature napta hai wo range se bahar hai

causes.en: Sensor open/short or wet/corroded connector.
causes.ur: Sensor open/short ya connector geela ya zang lageela

causes.en: Wrong sensor mounted or poor contact on the liquid line.
causes.ur: Ghalat sensor lga ho ya liquid line par contact kharab ho

solutions.en: Test the thermistor and replace it if out of specification.
solutions.ur: Thermistor test karein aur specification se bahar ho to badal dein

solutions.en: Dry/clean the connector and re-seat it, then reset the alarm.
solutions.ur: Connector ko sukha/saaf karke dobara lagayein, phir alarm reset karein

notes.en: Heat-pump fault list only - the published LED1-LED4 table has no row for 25, so the PCB pattern is unknown from this source. Official SET FREE 25 is outdoor gas-pipe thermistor.
notes.ur: Sirf heat-pump fault list mein hai — publish hui LED1-LED4 table mein 25 ka koi row nahi, is liye is source se PCB pattern maloom nahi. Official SET FREE 25 outdoor gas line ka thermistor hai.

meaning.en: The board's own protection circuit detected a fault and locked the unit out.
meaning.ur: Board ka apna protection circuit fault dekh kar unit ko rok kar rakh diya

causes.en: Over-voltage/under-voltage on the control supply, surge damage or a failing relay.
causes.ur: Control supply par over-voltage/under-voltage, surge se nuqsan ya kharab hota relay

causes.en: Moisture or dust contamination on the outdoor PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB par paani ya dust ka asar

solutions.en: Inspect the PCB for burnt tracks, swollen capacitors and tripped protection devices.
solutions.ur: PCB ko jaan kar jale hue tracks, phoolay hue capacitors aur trip ho chuke protection devices dekhein

solutions.en: Power down, clean/dry the board, check supply voltage and replace the board if damaged.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, board ko saaf aur sukha karein, supply voltage check karein aur nuqsan ho to board badal dein

notes.en: Listed in both heat-pump and cooling-only tables. Not to be confused with official SET FREE 38 (indoor fan motor / airflow).
notes.ur: Heat-pump aur cooling-only dono tables mein listed hai. Ise official SET FREE 38 (indoor fan motor / airflow) ke saath confuse nahi karna.

codes.blinkPattern: Remote LCD: ABNML + unit ID + 38; outdoor PCB LED2+LED3 lit

meaning.en: The cooling circuit is running overloaded and the unit shut down for protection.
meaning.ur: Cooling circuit zyada load par chal rahi hai aur unit protection ke liye band ho gaya

causes.en: Dirty condenser or restricted airflow raising head pressure during cooling.
causes.ur: Ganda condenser ya kam airflow ki wajah se cooling ke doran head pressure barh gaya

causes.en: Overcharge, non-condensables, weak capacitor or failing compressor winding.
causes.ur: Zyada charge, ghair mumine gas, kamzor capacitor ya compressor ki winding kharab hoti ja rahi hai

solutions.en: Clean the condenser, verify fan operation and measure head pressure/amp draw.
solutions.ur: Condenser saaf karein, fan ka kaam check karein aur head pressure/amp draw naapein.

solutions.en: Correct the charge or replace a weak run capacitor/compressor as found.
solutions.ur: Charge theek karein ya kamzor run capacitor/compressor ko jaisa mila hai waisa hi badal dein

notes.en: Heat-pump table only. SET FREE defines 41 as outdoor-fan circuit protection - related protection family, different naming.
notes.ur: Sirf heat-pump table mein hai. SET FREE mein 41 outdoor-fan circuit protection hai — protection ki hi family hai, naam bas alag hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Remote LCD: ABNML + unit ID + 41; outdoor PCB LED1+LED2 lit

meaning.en: The heating circuit is running overloaded and the unit shut down for protection.
meaning.ur: Heating circuit zyada load par chal rahi hai aur unit protection ke liye band ho gaya

causes.en: Low airflow over the outdoor coil in heating (iced coil, dirty fins, blocked fan).
causes.ur: Heating mein outdoor coil par kam airflow (jama hua coil, gande fins, band fan)

causes.en: Undercharge/leak, or compressor running long at high discharge temperature.
causes.ur: Charge kam ya leak, ya compressor high discharge temperature par lambi der chal raha hai

solutions.en: Clear the outdoor coil and fan, then check charge and discharge temperature.
solutions.ur: Pehle outdoor coil aur fan saaf karein, phir charge aur discharge temperature check karein.

solutions.en: Repair leaks and recharge; replace the compressor only if winding is bad.
solutions.ur: Leaks theek karke dobara charge karein; sirf tabhi compressor badlein jab winding kharab ho

codes.blinkPattern: Remote LCD: ABNML + unit ID + 42; outdoor PCB LED2+LED3+LED4 lit
